summary: Applied 4 spec-review repairs: optional report input, concrete decision routing, snake_case next-action fields, and acceptance-review completion guard.

items.title: Report context is required before it exists in the normal flow
items.rationale: Changed report context from an unconditional input to optional reportRefs used only when report.json already exists before finalize.
items.evidence: spec.json scope.in, overview.data_flow, overview.decisions, R5, and clarifications now state missing report.json before finalize is not a blocker.

items.title: Amendment and decision routes have no concrete flow integration target
items.rationale: Named `senti flow run acceptance-review`, `senti flow set acceptance-decision --choice <value>`, flow.json acceptanceReview state, and reset ranges for amend/retry and repair/reevaluate.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow[5], R10, R11, R12, clarifications[3], and T-4 implementation_notes now define the routing integration.

items.title: Next-action envelope field names conflict with the existing public contract
items.rationale: Changed public envelope language to preserve existing snake_case output_schema and requires_approval, with failurePolicy as additive metadata only.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.modules[1], R4, and AC5 now use output_schema and requires_approval.

items.title: Acceptance-review completion is not tied to the existing step completion guard
items.target: R5 / R8-R12 / R14 flow state promotion
items.rationale: Added flow-judgment-contract as the completion validation integration and added R15/AC15 requiring artifact-backed completion guard behavior.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.modules[3], overview.decisions[8], implementationTargets, R15, AC15, and task test strategies now cover completion guard behavior.
